question: How is wine shown to be Śiva-natured?
premises: There is no difference between Śiva and Śakti.
Wine produces the bliss of those rays.
inference: Since Śakti is non-different from Śiva and wine generates the bliss of Śakti's rays, wine is of the nature of Śiva.
uncertainties: marīcayaḥ may refer to mantra-rays or sensory radiances.
plain_english: There is no difference between Śiva and Śakti; the rays arise from Śakti, and wine produces their bliss. Therefore wine is of the nature of Śiva.
